# apipbx_follow_me (Resource)

An extension's follow-me. Import with "<tenant id>/<extension id>".



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `extension_id` (String) The extension that follows.
- `numbers` (List of String) 1-5 numbers: internal, or external through the outbound routes.
- `tenant_id` (String)

### Optional

- `confirm` (Boolean) An answerer on one of the numbers must press 1.
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `prering_seconds` (Number) The extension's own phone rings alone this long first (0-60).
- `ring_seconds` (Number) Then the phone and the numbers ring together this long (5-300).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
